params.name: include
params.description:
Using the include parameter, you can retrieve top-level resources.

- Files or main image. For example, `include=files,main_image`.
- Component product data. For example, `include=component_products`.
- Key attribute data, such as SKU or slug.

params.name: search_profile
params.description: The slug of the search profile to use for this search. Do not specify to use default search profile.

items.docs: Execute one or more searches in a single request.

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: The ID of the catalog to query

params.name: release_id
params.description: The unique ID of a published release of the catalog or `latestPublished` for the most recently published version

params.name: facet_by
params.description: Specifies which fields to use for generating facets in search results. See [faceting](/guides/How-To/Catalogs/Search/faceting) for more details.

params.name: filter_by
params.description: Applies conditions to narrow down search results based on specific field values. See [filtering](/guides/How-To/Catalogs/Search/filtering) for more details.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Orders search results by specified fields. See [sorting](/guides/How-To/Catalogs/Search/sorting) for more details.

params.name: max_facet_values
params.description: Maximum number of facet values to return
